How do you evaluate omitted information and unsupported statements before a summary reaches a clinician?
Can you accept a non-credit-bearing NUS-ISS Student Pass internship, what duration is required, and is EP sponsorship possible for subsequent full-time work?

Explain an auditable ingestion API with authentication, retries, idempotency and separate family-facing and clinical summaries.
